subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Bug Bounty Programs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Bug Bounty Programs usable.

hook.text: A teenager finds a critical flaw in Facebook. Instead of exploiting it, they report it and earn $30,000.

buildup.text: Bug bounty programs pay external researchers to find and report security vulnerabilities responsibly.

discovery.text: They provide continuous testing from diverse perspectives that internal teams can't fully replicate.

twist.text: Well-run programs define scope clearly. Without rules, researchers probe areas that cause disruptions.

climax.text: Google's bug bounty has paid over $50 million. The vulnerabilities found would have cost far more if exploited.

punchline.text: Pay the good hackers. It's cheaper than paying the bad ones.

quiz.question: What do bug bounty programs incentivize?
